bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
p=/home/admin1/projects/ai-core
git -C "$p" rev-parse HEAD
docker inspect -f '{{.Image}} {{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}} {{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.working_dir"}} {{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.config_files"}}' ai-core-model-gate
docker exec ai-core-model-gate python3 -c 'from runtime.remote_model_gate import validate_completion,MODEL_ID; x=validate_completion(dict(model=MODEL_ID,messages=[dict(role="system",content="s"),dict(role="user",content="u")],max_tokens=32,temperature=0,stream=False,response_format=dict(type="json_object"))); print("REASONING",x.get("reasoning","UNSET"))'
docker exec ai-core-model-gate python3 -c 'import os,json,urllib.request;h={"Authorization":"Bearer "+os.environ["AI_CORE_API_KEY"]};u=urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:18185/internal/handoff/status",headers=h);d=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(u,timeout=5));print("COORDINATOR",json.dumps({k:d.get(k) for k in ("resident","active","handoff","recovery_pending","queued")}))'
docker exec ai-core-model-gate sha256sum /app/runtime/remote_model_gate.py
